name: Daily Login Reward
tagline: A system that gives users a reward simply for opening the app each day.
desc: The reward typically increases with consecutive days logged in, creating a compounding incentive to return. Unlike the streak, the login reward does not require completing a core action, it rewards presence alone. The risk is training users to open, collect, and leave without engaging the core loop.
principle: Presence rewarded before engagement. Useful for habit formation but weak as a standalone mechanic without a reason to stay after collecting.
warn: Login rewards attract reward-chasers with no interest in the core product. Track whether users who engage primarily via login rewards convert to core loop engagement or churn after the reward track ends.
lifecycle: High value days 0–14. Diminishing returns after habit forms.
